excluded_context: Do not use injective-fiber as the default theorem hypothesis; it is only a stronger corollary.
Do not treat the route-local obstruction as a global impossibility theorem.
expected_next_step_signal: End with a final line of the form: Suggested next local action: <one sentence>.
goal: Given the currently banked results, recommend the single best next branch for one more proof cycle. Rank only live options. Distinguish clearly between: (i) keeping the current exact route banked in conditional form, (ii) testing one genuinely new raw-message posterior-labeling principle if there is a coherent one, and (iii) switching to a different beyond-finite-M route. Prefer concrete theorem-producing routes and reject dead-end replays.
hard_constraints: Do not reopen the exact route hinge unless you can name a genuinely new raw-message posterior-labeling principle not already ruled out.
Do not restart from finite-M work or from the false compact-topology or atomic truncation routes.
Prefer branches that could still produce a real theorem rather than another abstract obstruction.
proof_state_update_target: Update the durable proof-state so the next branch choice after the reviewer-cleared raw-message obstruction is explicit.
required_output: Return only substantive markdown. Give: Current settled frontier, Ranked next-branch options, and Chosen next branch with one precise first local lemma. End with a short paragraph titled Why this is worth one more cycle.
scope: Choose the next beyond-finite-M proof branch after the reviewer-cleared fiber non-identifiability obstruction. The current least-strengthened exact route is conditionally settled at its hinge and should not be probed again unless there is a genuinely new posterior-labeling principle.
